component.name: Linernotes
component.summary: Modern local music player with AI-powered features
具备智能辅助功能的现代本地音乐播放器

description.p: Linernotes is an open-source, local-first desktop music player enhanced by AI. It empowers your music collection with intelligent tag correction, conversational search, smart playlist generation, and contextual radio hosting.
Linernotes 是一款面向本地音乐收藏者的开源桌面音乐播放器。 通过 AI 辅助为曲库提供智能乱码与标签修复、自然语言交互检索、智能曲线歌单以及电台主持人串场等功能。
Initial release with local library management, playback, and AI integrations.
初始发布版本，支持本地曲库管理、音频播放与 AI 智能辅助。
